proposal.headline: Raise the fold crest enough to expose the slender Madison core
proposal.observation: The observed axial belt contains slender purple Madison exposures from the middle of the crop toward its southeast edge, whereas the prediction has none. The predicted oldest exposed belt is predominantly Tensleep blue, with almost no Amsden.
proposal.expected_effect: Introduce a narrow Madison core and a resolvable Amsden envelope along the axis, while moving the surrounding contacts modestly outward; the broad northeastern Jurassic mismatch may remain.
